note: nidene ADV below — "oben vnd niden" = above and below, "alter niden an dem" = altar below, all ADV
site NOM custom/manner — "wenne diser site was der" = this custom, "dem selben site weihe" = same custom, all NOM
schenke NOM cupbearer — "vorweser der schenken", "probst der schenken", all NOM (not schenken VRB)
wunde NOM wound — "so der wunden ł smerczen", "enpfehet eyne wunden", all NOM wound
drücken VRB press — "drucke wir sie", "noch drucke in mit", all VRB press/squeeze
recken VRB to stretch — "ł recken mein hant" = stretch my hand, all VRB (not recke ADJ)
turn NOM tower — "beiden hinder turn so wirt" = both behind the tower, all NOM tower
sache NOM matter/case — "meinen wider sachen" = my adversaries/cases, NOM plural
sîn VEX to be (subjunctive) — "das es sey EXO ein" = that it be, all VEX subjunctive sein
mâl NOM time/instance — "zu einem mal wil ich" = once/at one time I will, NOM
brechen VRB broken — "stein ous gebrochen hat vnd" = stone broken out, VRB past participle
bürde NOM burden — "gelegt die purde alles dises" = laid the burden of all this, NOM
soln VEM should — "ir antlicze solde sie nicht" = her face should she not, VEM past
helle NOM hell — "in die helle so wisset" = into hell so know, NOM (not hel ADJ lemma_2734)
enge ADJ narrow/passage — "in einer enge czweier mowern" = in the narrows of two walls, NOM/ADJ
erhaben ADJ raised/elevated — "Ouf erhaben wirt durch" = lifted up will be, ADJ past part (not erheben VRB)
slahen VRB strike! — "Slahe dich got" = may God strike you, VRB subjunctive/imperative
wilde ADJ wild — "opfern sam wilde czigen" = offer like wild goats, ADJ (not NAM lemma_11955)
hôch ADJ high — "ouf die hoe erde" = upon the high earth, ADJ (not hœhe NOM lemma_2881)
offenbære ADJ open/manifest — "LEUITICUS ein offenbare vnreinikeit" = a manifest uncleanness, ADJ
gerte NOM rod/switch — "nam albereine gerten grune vnd" = took fresh green rods, NOM plural
senden VRB send! — "Sende dorumme nv", "Sende man die", all VRB imperative
erschellen VRB to sound/ring — "her erschellen wirt die", "erschellen soltu die", all VRB
brant NOM burning/brand — "brant vmb brant" = burning for burning (Exodus lex talionis), all NOM
verre ADJ farther/further — "noch hoher verrer tack vnd" = still higher, farther day, comparative ADJ
wê ADJ/INJ woe — "We dir Uorgangen", "sprach aber We wer wirt", "Und sprach We herre got", all INJ woe
wizzen VRB know! — "Wisse vorwissende das", "Wisse dorumme heute", all VRB imperative
swære ADJ heavy — "alczu swer ich wil" = too heavy, "hende waren swer" = hands were heavy, all ADJ
heben VRB lifted/began — "do huben sich an" = they set about/began, "ouf huben sie das" = lifted that, all VRB
vordern NOM/VRB to demand — "wil ich vordern vnd von", "wil ich vordern des menschen", all VRB demand
jener ADJ those/any — "namen von ienen steten" = from those places, "an ienen fride" = in any peace
